name: carousel-text-circle-1-vertical
title: Text + Circle Carousel 1 (vertical)
description: Vertical a headline mask-reveals word by word while a circle carousel converges from off-frame and threads the line, collapses to centre, hard-cuts to a second line that arrives at 1.4× (Circle style 1), the curve rebuilt for the 780 field. Images and speed are variables; placement full (brand ground), top or bottom; runs or fades out.
